command: set -euo pipefail; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; id -un; date -Is; echo '===LOCAL_LLM==='; for x in ollama llama-server llama-cli mistral; do printf '%s=' "$x"; command -v "$x" || true; done; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then ollama list 2>/dev/null || true; fi; echo '===DB_CANDIDATES==='; find /home/ai-core-node -xdev -type f \( -name 'unified.db' -o -name 'consciousness.db' -o -name 'amygdala.db' -o -name 'world_experience.db' \) -printf '%p|%s|%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>/dev/null | sort; echo '===UNIFIED_TABLES==='; for db in $(find /home/ai-core-node -xdev -type f -name unified.db 2>/dev/null | head -10); do echo DB=$db; sqlite3 -readonly "$db" "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,120p' || true; done; echo '===REPOS==='; find /home/ai-core-node -xdev -maxdepth 5 -type d -name .git -print 2>/dev/null | sed 's#/.git$##' | sort | head -200 | while read -r r; do printf '%s|' "$r"; git -C "$r" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo NOHEAD; done; echo PREFLIGHT_DONE=1
